01Our story

The Global Guru Story

It did not start in an office. It started with a conversation.

A juice point, two friends

About eight years ago, at a small juice point, two friends kept returning to one simple idea: "Find people's problems — and become their solution." That sentence became the seed of Global Guru.

Built from zero

No office, no investor, no team. E-commerce was learned the hard way — selling online, running stores, watching accounts get closed and income stop, then starting again from zero. Every lesson was paid for in real experience.

Bigger Water

One belief shaped everything: do not stay a big fish in a small pond. Grow into the ocean. Today we help other businesses do the same — branding that builds trust, marketing that communicates, websites that create credibility, and AI that accelerates growth.

The smile in our logo

The smile inside the GG mark stands for Confidence, Trust, Growth and Partnership. Global Guru's face will never be a stock photo — it is the work, the word, and the relationship we build with every client.

From local roots to the world

Global Guru began in Multan, Pakistan. Today we serve clients across Pakistan, the UAE, the UK, the USA, Canada, Australia, Germany and Italy — one standard everywhere: honest work, clear prices, real growth.
